THE allotment of land speciﬁ ed more fully in the Order No. 06 of 2021 dated 28.12.2020 made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2209/46 dated 07.01.2021 was vested in the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. The possession of the land depicted below has not yet been taken for and on behalf of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. Therefore, I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, by virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 39(1) of the land Acquisition Act, do hereby revoke the land speciﬁ ed in the Schedule of the Order No. 06 of 2021 dated 28.12.2020 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2209/46 dated 07.01.2021.
